newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ANZ unit sells AFL consumer finance stake.
newsitem.headline: ANZ unit sells AFL consumer finance stake.

text.p: UDC, a unit of Wellington- based ANZ Group, said on Monday it had sold its 50 percent interest in consumer finance company Amalgamated Finance Limited to Auckland company Frontline Finance.
In a statement UDC said it was consolidating its position as New Zealand's largest finance company, concentrating on its specialisation in financing "significant business assets".
The disposal stemmed from AFL not fitting this profile.
It gave no financial details of the sale but said the deal wouldd take effect from September 30.
